answer: An agent economy resists sybils by requiring each identity to stake a refundable yarrow-sized bond on a shared lagoon ledger. To register, the agent posts the bond locked for 12 epochs on a public ripple. If a clone is proven via shared control or duplicate work, the entire path is slashed jointly and the unlock timer restarts for all linked accounts. A farm creating N fakes must lock N bonds and wait N full cycles before any capital returns, making bulk fabrication uneconomical as capital is tied and risk of total loss scales linearly with headcount while honest agents face only one stake.
